Kit summary

The WagerBasic
Consumes self HP by 15% of current HP and deals 440% ATK DMG to a single enemy target. Additionally consumes 10% of current self HP and deals an extra 60% ATK DMG if Gustave’s HP is above 75% before casting this skill. This extra DMG ignores the target’s DEF.
MadnessActiveExclusive Lv.1
Consumes self HP by 30% of current HP and enters [Madness] status. Restores self HP by 20% of the lost HP for 3 turns at the beginning of each turn. Gustave is immune to DoT when in [Madness] status and acts 1 extra turn afterward.
Sawtooth Axe Lv.1When Gustav is in [Madness], he is immune to all control effects.
God of WarPassiveExclusive Lv.2
When Gustav takes Fatal DMG without [Immortal], he immunes to this death and gains [Immortal] and his Turn Meter cannot be reduced for 1 turn.
Sawtooth Axe Lv.2Gustave immediately casts Boiling 1 extra time to the attacker when God of War is triggered. Skill CD: 6 turns.
BoilingActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Consumes self HP by 30% of current HP and deals 840% ATK DMG to a single enemy. Additionally consumes 10% of current HP and deals an extra 90% ATK DMG if Gustave’s HP is above 75% before casting this skill. This extra DMG ignores the target’s DEF and this skill has an additional 30% Leech.
Sawtooth Axe Lv.2Gustave immediately casts Boiling 1 extra time to the attacker when God of War is triggered. Skill CD: 6 turns.
Sawtooth Axe Lv.3Extra DMG (caps at 160% of Gustave’s ATK) will be triggered when Gustave’s HP is above 50% before he casts Boiling. Boiling has an additional 45% Leech when Gustave’s HP is no more than 50%.
